submittedIntro: cyYour possession claim has been submitted. We’ve sent you a confirmation email.
cyIf you need to submit a general application as part of this claim, you must do it within 24 hours.
cyYou can submit a general application by selecting ‘Ask the court to make an order (make a general application)’ on your case overview.
cyIf you need support to use HMCTS services, either before or during a hearing, you must let us know as soon as possible.
whatHappensNext: cyThe claim will be sent to the defendants and they can respond.
cyThe court will schedule a hearing where a judge will consider the claim and any response and make a decision. You should attend the hearing.
